results.query: افضل وحدة عندكم في السعر مقابل المساحة
results.expected_filter: sort by (Area / Price) DESC, take top 1
results.code:
df['Price'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Price'], errors='coerce')
df['Area'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Area'], errors='coerce')
df['Garden'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Garden'], errors='coerce')
df['Roof'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Roof'], errors='coerce')

df['price_per_area'] = df['Price'] / df['Area']

selected_units = df.sort_values(by='price_per_area').head(50)

# Filter for apartments
